title: Saha Residence
subtitle: Contemporary Residential Architecture & Elevation Design
description: A 2,200 sq.ft. contemporary home in Gangarampur with a bold layered façade, combining terracotta-toned horizontal cladding, a full-height glazed stair core, cantilevered balconies, a black steel pergola terrace and a car porch with a sculpted LED ceiling.
body:
Designed for Joydeb Saha in Gangarampur, this 2,200 sq.ft. residence gives a compact urban plot a confident contemporary identity. Currently under construction, the house is organised as a two-storey home with a usable roof terrace, with the façade treated as a composition of layered volumes rather than a flat front.

At the centre, a full-height glazed stair core with a patterned black screen is framed by terracotta-toned horizontal cladding, forming the vertical spine of the elevation. On either side, grey cantilevered balconies with glass railings and a deep black steel pergola over the first-floor terrace create depth, shade and strong shadow lines.

At ground level, a cantilevered car porch with a sculpted LED ceiling, a fin-screened sit-out and a timber-finish main door make for a welcoming arrival. Terraces and pergolas on each level bring outdoor living into the design, suited to the warm local climate.
features.0.title: A Layered Contemporary Façade
features.0.text: The front elevation is composed as a set of interlocking volumes. Grey cantilevered balcony boxes, a terracotta-toned horizontal cladding band and a deep black steel pergola are layered against each other, giving the house depth, shadow and a strong street presence.
features.1.title: Glazed Stair Core
features.1.text: A full-height glazed slot at the centre of the façade marks the staircase, finished with a patterned black screen that filters daylight inside and glows at night. Framed by the horizontal cladding, it becomes the vertical spine of the elevation.
features.2.title: Terraces, Pergolas & Outdoor Living
features.2.text: Outdoor space is built into every level. A first-floor terrace sits under a black steel pergola with a lattice-pattern railing, hanging planters and lighting, while the roof carries a second pergola with a glass railing and planters for open-air use.
highlights.0.title: Horizontal Cladding Band
highlights.0.text: Terracotta-toned horizontal fins frame the stair core and give the façade warmth and rhythm.
highlights.1.title: Glazed Stair Core
highlights.1.text: Full-height glazing with a patterned screen lights the staircase and marks the entrance.
highlights.2.title: Steel Pergola Terrace
highlights.2.text: A deep black steel pergola shades the first-floor terrace above the car porch.
highlights.3.title: Car Porch with LED Ceiling
highlights.3.text: A cantilevered porch with a sculpted linear LED pattern on its soffit.
highlights.4.title: Cantilevered Balconies
highlights.4.text: Grey balcony boxes with glass railings and concealed downlights project from the façade.
highlights.5.title: Ground-Floor Sit-Out
highlights.5.text: A vertical fin screen wraps a shaded sit-out beside the main entrance.
